generationInputs.prompt: A vintage snark poster rendered in an optical illusion style with a black and white color palette, featuring a luminous donut, an eggplant, a banana, and viscous white liquid. The black and white image showcases a luminous donut with white spilled milk and diamonds, with a holographic effect. From its center emerge two female legs in black fishnet stockings and high-heeled shoes, and two hands, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid, the other a glass pipe. An eggplant and a banana, each holding a glowing syringe, and bright viscous white liquid are arranged around the donut. The poster features numerous wavy, concentric, and parallel lines creating a dynamic, abstract, and mesmerizing optical illusion.
